text:
sofia-customer: Hi team — since yesterday our integration started failing when we call the `reserve_order` tool. We get a 400 and "invalid function args".

anna-support: Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the exact payload you sent? Any changes on your side recently?

sofia-customer: We switched to JSON mode on the SDK and trimmed some fields. Payload (redacted):
````json
{"order_id": "12345", "items": [["sku_1", 2]], "customer": {"id": "c-987"}}
````
We used to send `items` as a list of objects but converted to compact arrays to save tokens.

anna-support: ah — the tool schema expects `items: [{"sku": string, "qty": number}]` not nested arrays. Can you reproduce with the old shape?

sofia-customer: Reverting to objects fixes it for one customer, but we're seeing intermittent 500s on other calls even with the correct shape.

deploy-bot: Alert: 5xx spike on /v1/functions/call in us-east-1 — 15 errors in last 5m.

dave-sre: I see elevated tail latency and a small subset of errors show `json_decode_error: expected object but got array` in the runtime logs. Pasting snippet:
````
2026-03-10T17:02:11Z runtime-1 ERROR decode.go:87 json: cannot unmarshal array into Go struct field Item.sku of type string
````

ben-ml: This matches a schema coercion issue we patched earlier — the runtime accepts both shapes when using permissive parsing, but JSON mode forces strict schema validation for declared function args. If the model emits the compact array shape, the validator will reject.

charlie-eng: Do we have a graceful fallback? Shouldn't we coerce arrays -> objects if keys match expected pattern? That would avoid customer breakage.

anna-support: Customer is asking for a short-term workaround and a repro checklist so they can revert quickly if they see errors.

ben-ml: Short-term: revert to object-shaped `items` on the client. I'll add a validator patch to accept compact arrays where `items` schema is [sku, qty] but need QA. Also we should patch error message to include the offending path.

emily-billing: Noted — opening a waived-billing request for request IDs in this thread while we triage.

sofia-customer: Can you provide a minimal repro we can run locally? Our CI hit it on 2026-03-10 17:01:05 UTC.

anna-support: Repro steps for your engineers:
1) Set SDK to JSON mode (json_mode: true)
2) Call `/v1/functions/call` with model `gpt-open-qr` and function `reserve_order`
3) Use compact items payload: `{"order_id":"X","items":[["sku",1]],"customer":{"id":"c"}}`
4) Observe 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid function args", "details":"json: cannot unmarshal array into object at items[0]"}`

charlie-eng: I'll prioritize a small runtime tweak: if schema type is object but model output is array and function def has a `compact_array_hint` in metadata, attempt transform. Will add feature flag `lenient_fn_arg_coercion`.

dave-sre: For now, rate-limit the retries from the failing integration to avoid cascading 5xx retries. Also added a temporary route-level retry cap.

sofia-customer: Thanks — implementing the object shape now and will monitor. Please update when the feature flag/patch lands.

anna-support: We'll follow up here with a patch PR and rollout ETA. Thanks for the detailed repro, it sped this up. :pray:
